What's new

Snake Measurer 1.8.3

Small improvements.

This update makes it easier to fill in an animal's profile and share its card.

Morph in the profile. You can now add your animal's morph as well as its species. It also appears on profile, measurement and comparison cards when you share them.

Profile card first. When you share an animal from the list, its profile appears first, followed by the photo comparison when available.

A clearer first measurement. We fixed the card outline in the tutorial example. The “Try an example” button makes it clearer that this is a demonstration, and you can choose your own photo afterwards.

We also improved the profile form on small screens.
